goal: Find more pairs of cards than the others.
loop: On their turn a player turns two cards; a pair scores and they go again, a miss passes the turn.
actions: Turn a card on your turn.
private_information: Which symbol a face-down card hides.
rounds: Turns until every pair is found.
ending: Every pair is found; the most pairs wins.
assets: cardBack: the back of a card (optional; drawn when missing).
